description_en: Queries a list of standalone AI model sources
name: ListAiModelSources

parameters.help_en: The ID of the AI gateway instance to which the resource belongs
parameters.help_zh: 资源所属的 AI 网关实例 ID
parameters.name: gateway_id

parameters.help_en: The stable identifier of the model provider
parameters.help_zh: 模型提供者的稳定标识
parameters.name: provider

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of results per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. This parameter is required. Token-based pagination does not use pageNumber or pageSize
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token returned from the previous page. Omit this parameter for the first page. For the last page, this parameter is empty or omitted
parameters.help_zh: 上一页返回的查询位置；首页省略，末页为空或省略
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The query keyword used to match resources by name or identifier
parameters.help_zh: 按名称或标识匹配资源的查询关键词
parameters.name: keyword

code.description_en: The response status code. A value of Ok indicates success, and a specific business error code indicates failure
code.description_zh: 响应状态码。成功时返回 Ok，失败时返回具体业务错误码

data.description_en: The business result returned by the model source operation
data.description_zh: 模型源操作返回的业务结果

items.description_en: The list of model sources returned on the current page
items.description_zh: 本页查询返回的模型源列表

displayName.description_en: The display name of the model source or model provider
displayName.description_zh: 模型源或模型提供者的展示名称

gatewayId.description_en: The ID of the AI gateway instance to which the resource belongs
gatewayId.description_zh: 资源所属的 AI 网关实例 ID

modelSourceId.description_en: The model source ID. Use the modelSourceId returned by CreateAiModelSource
modelSourceId.description_zh: 模型源 ID，使用 CreateAiModelSource 返回的 modelSourceId

provider.description_en: The stable identifier of the model provider
provider.description_zh: 模型提供者的稳定标识

serviceId.description_en: The ID of the actual AI service bound to the model source
serviceId.description_zh: 模型源绑定的实际 AI 服务 ID

updateTime.description_en: The time of the last business update, in RFC 3339 format and the UTC time zone
updateTime.description_zh: 最近一次业务更新时间，采用 RFC 3339 格式并使用 UTC 时区

version.description_en: The current version of the object, which is used for conditional validation during updates or deletions
version.description_zh: 对象当前版本，更新或删除时用于条件校验

maxResults.description_en: The maximum number of records returned per page
maxResults.description_zh: 单页最多返回的记录数量

nextToken.description_en: The pagination token returned from the previous page. Do not specify this parameter when you query the first page
nextToken.description_zh: 上一页返回的分页标识；查询首页时不传入

totalCount.description_en: The total number of records that match the current query conditions
totalCount.description_zh: 匹配当前查询条件的记录总数

message.description_en: The response message, which describes the request processing result
message.description_zh: 响应消息，用于说明请求处理结果

requestId.description_en: The request ID, which is generated by the system to trace the current call
requestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，由系统生成，用于定位本次调用
